title: Landing Of Pistols And Ammunition At Central Wharf

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY

January 6, 1932.

Deputy Commissioner (Divisions).

Sir,

Landing of pistols and ammunition
at Central Wharf

At 2 p.m. today, a Mr. Golding of Messrs. Varden
and Co., called to see me re a Police escort for one
of the Company's vans, which is to convey two cases of
pistols and ammunition, from a ship arriving tomorrow
morning at the Central Wharf, to the Belgian Consulate.
at the corner of Route Pichon and Ru Lafayette. The
French Police taking up the escort at the corner of
Avenue Foch and Avenue du Roi Albert.

Mr. Golding was in possession of permits, from the
Harbour Master, and the Customs, also from the Chief
Officer of the Fire Brigade.

Jactmelan.
Divisional Officer "C" Division.

（批：Elm 7/）
Commission of Police
Information. Arrangements made by D.O "C" Div
to provide an escort of 2 men through
Settlement
（签名：leofspringfield.）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处

1932年1月6日。

副总监（各区）。

先生：

关于手枪及弹药在中央码头登陆事宜

今日下午二时，瓦登公司（Messrs. Varden and Co.）的戈尔丁（Golding）先生前来拜会，商请警方为该公司一辆货车提供护卫。该货车拟将两箱手枪及弹药，从明晨抵达中央码头的船上运往位于贝当路（Route Pichon）与霞飞路（Rue Lafayette）转角处的比利时领事馆。法国警察将在福煦路（Avenue Foch）与阿尔伯特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）转角处接手护卫任务。

戈尔丁先生持有港务长、海关以及消防队队长签发的许可证。

贾克特梅兰（Jactmelan）。
“C”区分区警官。

（批注：Elm 7/）
警务处
知悉。“C”区分区警官已安排由两名警员在租界境内提供护卫。
（签名：leofspringfield.）
